# rg

Search text with regular expressions, globs and ignore rules through MoonX.

## Usage

```sh
moonx cli/rg -n 'TODO' .

moonx cli/rg -F -g '*.mbt' 'StringBuilder' .

printf 'hello\n' | moonx cli/rg 'hello' -
```

Supply an explicit path, or - for stdin. Unicode regex matching, ignore files, file-type filters and JSON output are supported.

## Common options

| Option | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `--regexp PATTERN`, `-e PATTERN` | A pattern to search for. |
| `--files` | Print each file that would be searched. |
| `--fixed-strings`, `-F` | Treat all patterns as literals. Default: `false`. |
| `--no-fixed-strings` | Disable `--fixed-strings`. |
| `--glob GLOB`, `-g GLOB` | Include or exclude file paths. |
| `--help`, `-h` | Show help. |
| `--hidden`, `-.` | Search hidden files and directories. Default: `false`. |
| `--no-hidden` | Disable `--hidden`. |
| `--ignore-case`, `-i` | Case insensitive search. |
| `--json` | Show search results in a JSON Lines format. |
| `--no-json` | Disable `--json`. |
| `--line-number`, `-n` | Print one-based line numbers. Off by default on every output destination; -n enables them explicitly. |
| `--version`, `-V` | Show the version. |
<!-- END GENERATED OPTIONS -->

Use `--help` for the complete option list.

## Notes

Build from source with the MoonBit 1.0 RC1 toolchain.

- PCRE2, compressed search (-z), one-filesystem traversal and byte-based DFA cache limits are unsupported.
- Search runs on one thread without memory mapping. Multiline mode may retain the complete input.
- Automatic terminal detection is unavailable: color, headings and line numbers require explicit options. Use --help for the full option list.

See the [compatibility guide](../../docs/compatibility.md) for the supported profile.
